description: One capability a plugin's service declares, and what this build makes of it.

filling.description:
What asking for it would come to, or nothing where nothing can ask.

A namespaced capability has no answer here rather than an empty one: nothing
consumes it, which is what *inert* means, and reporting it as unfilled would be
describing a gap where there is a design.

own.description: Whether it is this plugin's own rather than one from the core vocabulary.

probes.description: Every probe the claim binds, in the order the vocabulary declares them.

shown.description: How far the claim has been shown.
